reviewer.description: Who produced this report: correctness, design, codex, or verify.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: overall verdict, and say plainly if nothing significant was found.

id.description: Reviewer prefix plus number, e.g. C1, D2, X3, V1.

claim.description: What is wrong and what goes wrong as a result.

evidence.description: The code, spec text, or observed behaviour that shows it.

repro.description: Command, input, or failing test demonstrating it, with observed output. Empty string if not feasible.

suggested_fix.description: The smallest change that fixes it.
